haberler.baslik: McKinsey on harnessing AI to make mining safer
haberler.ozet: A recent report from McKinsey & Co’s Metals & Mining Practice discusses harnessing AI to make mining safer. The McKinsey authors – Henrique Fagundes, Vishal Agarwal, and Yanto Yanto – argue that AI could improve both safety and productivity by anticipating problems before they arise, detecting worker fatigue and automating dangerous tasks.
